lists.name: RYM Top — Rock — Garage Rock Revival

podcast.body: In 2007, the band returned to their punk and blues roots with this album, which became their last studio release. It achieved significant commercial success, selling over a million copies globally, shortly before they announced their separation. "lanzaron su último disco, Iqtamb, Album del cual vendieron más de un millón de copias."

srcs.episode: Por qué White Stripes desaparecieron en su mejor momento?

podcast.body: The title track of "Icky Thump" was mentioned as the last album released by The White Stripes before their breakup in 2011. The album came out in 2007. "Here's the title track of the last white stripes album, Iki Thumb, in 2007."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 7: (40-31)

podcast.body: This album notably won the Grammy Award for Best Alternative Album in 2007, triumphing over Arcade Fire's "Neon Bible" in the same category. "It got a nomination for Best Alternative Album at the Grammys which it lost to Iki Thumb from the White Stripes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
